Hello,
We are the Charging Point Operator (CPO) of 33 Jalan Buroh station, which is operating with
1 x Siemens Sicharge-D
unit located in Singapore. As part of the upcoming transition, we will be handing over the CPO responsibilities to the new operator, SPM.
In order to ensure a smooth handover, SPM will require full control of the station with the same level of access and functionality that we currently maintain. This includes the ability to:
(open/close the station, reboot the system, initiate and stop charging sessions, view operational logs).
Could you kindly advise on the procedure and steps required on your end to facilitate this transition?
We look forward to your instructions.
Daniel Fernandez
